QuestInfo.name: [Red Leaf High] Mission: Ghost in the Music Room
QuestInfo.1: It seems that the ghost in the music room has acquired a new Sheet Music. The ghost plays the music with all its might but it's so bad no one can figure out what song it is. Take the Sheet Music from the girl so that no one has to put up with the horrifying music.
QuestInfo.2: It seems that the ghost in the music room has acquired a new Sheet Music. The ghost plays the music with all its might but it's so bad no one can figure out what song it is. The Sheet Music from the girl was taken so that no one has to put up with the horrifying music.

0.0: I think the girl ghost in the music room got her hands on some music sheets. I heard her playing last night in the music room...it was awful. Where did she find the sheets!? We need to take the sheets away from her. #b#h0##k, I know I can count on you.

yes.0: I feel sorry for the girl, but I'd really rather not hear her play again. Her song will drive me insane and it'll disrupt other classes. Please, help us. Door on the right will take you to the music room.
